parsed.note_claim: Johnson, Sautter and other officials were on a separate chartered train that was stopped and partly evacuated, not the train that was struck.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Günter Sautter, reiste demnach in der Nacht mit einem privat gecharterten Zug von Kiew nach Polen. Am frühen Morgen sei der Zug dann nahe der polnischen Grenze gestoppt, wegen Drohnen seien Teile des Zuges evakuiert worden.
parsed.reason: The article confirms officials traveled on a privately chartered train that was stopped and evacuated, distinguishing it from the regular passenger train whose locomotive was hit by a drone.
